periods.name: COVID shock
periods.description: February–April 2020 holding months. Tests loss protection during the sudden market disruption.

periods.name: COVID recovery
periods.description: May–December 2020 holding months. Tests participation in the recovery after the initial shock.

periods.name: Inflation / rate shock
periods.description: January–December 2022 holding months. Tests the model during the inflation and rate-shock environment.

sources.name: Initial unemployment claims
sources.feature: Three-month percentage change in the latest available four-week average
sources.availability: Observation Saturday + five calendar days (Thursday); latest revised vintage

sources.name: Baa corporate–Treasury spread
sources.feature: Spread level and one-month change, percentage points
sources.availability: One business day after observation; broad Baa proxy, not LQD OAS

sources.name: 10-year minus 3-month yield curve
sources.feature: Latest available spread level, percentage points

settings.trade_timing: Last-trading-day decision; enter next trading-day close and exit next rebalance close. Holding month names the entry month.
